faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about setting up and getting paid
faq.q1: Do I need a registered company or formal license to get started?
faq.a1: No. BioPay is built from the ground up to let independent creators, home boutiques, and social sellers start taking orders immediately with just their mobile number.
faq.q2: When and how do I receive my sales earnings?
faq.a2: All cleared customer payments are settled directly and automatically into your verified bank account in regular daily cycles.
faq.q3: How do my customers complete their payment?
faq.a3: Customers tap your link in Instagram bio, add items to cart, and check out securely using their bank card with zero app download required.
faq.q4: Can customers also order via WhatsApp?
faq.a4: Yes! Every product features an 'Order via WhatsApp' option that automatically pre-fills the cart details and sends it directly to your WhatsApp inbox.
